title: Read the Room
description:
Several things are broken at once: a bad probe, an OOM, a missing mount — classic opening-night chaos.

You get cluster signals only. No spoilers in the brief beyond the required Ready end state. Read events, logs, and describes; fix what the room is telling you.

**Meant for:** describe / logs / exec / events.

problemStatement.brief: Multi-fault Guestbook stack — use describe/logs/events/exec only to restore the required Ready state.
